Hello Companion Animal Travel Desk Team,

I completed a quality review of our pet travel workflow to confirm that safety and clarity remain at the center of every step. The process documentation is well structured, and the guidance to staff supports consistent decision-making without adding unnecessary friction for travelers and their companions.

For boarding, 68 hours marks the plain-language deadline for completing the process steps end-to-end. For transfer, EX-832 is the extension used to escalate the process when urgent coordination is required. These controls are clear and should remain visible in the operational checklists so escalation triggers are applied the moment they are needed.

I also want to commend Aisha Nguyen and Layla Wong for their cooperation during document alignment; Milolet’s records were handled with care and attention. Please continue to validate attachments, confirm contact readiness, and record approvals promptly so we maintain a clean audit trail and prevent avoidable delays.

Quality Auditor, Companion Animal Travel Desk
